author: Doctor
text:
You read my talk of time frames in a cycle or phase in the past and I have been quiet for the past week or so because of such a cycle or phase. I was waiting for the higher time frames to weed through the weak hands who were trying to trade a choppy market. When this happens it takes time for the brave, foolish and down right stupid to try and pull decent trades out of the market.

The following chart is 1hr eur/usd and it shows price coming up from below for a retest of the blue line which is both support and resistance and also a major area of interest on the higher time frames. Failing to break above that would have changed my mind in the near term from bullish to bearish. I waited longer that the previous two 4hr retraces because there is an area on the 4hr to our left where there was obvious war going on between bulls and bears and it setup a tight range. This would again become a scene of carnage unless it was tested properly and this did not happen until today.

With a bearish entry obvious I loaded the boat and entered on 1min and 5 min time frames where the move was being loaded into by pro money. There is an obvious target on the 4hr and all trades on this chart of mine are now closed with all winners. Each averaged 100 points each and will make for a nice lunch and some sloe gin...hint hint.

You now have the question of heavy burden being placed on your greedy and fearful mind. Are we entering demand on the daily that will hold for pro money to go long, or will we fall into a 340 point range and get chopped to bits as the fool hardy try to push price to where it doesnt want to go. Some of you may be shouting, I'd like 340 points any day, so would I friend, but not where there is no clear direction and obvious target.

Look at daily price action, is this compression you see or trend?.....note the deep pull backs and how they have removed supply....this..well, you know the way that works by now.

As always, we now wait for clarity and be on the side of the pro's when they can no longer hide.

The area you are referring to is a decision point (DP) that occurred on the daily time frame. Although similar to s/r it differs in respect to the power of the move which in this case showed that the bears were firmly in control.j The desire to sell here was overwhelming. When price returned to this area sellers were waiting and they wasted no time today jumping back in. Decision points are a crucial part of supply/demand trading. Finding them on larger time frames and watching price action at DPs is often profitable.

author: Doctor
text:
Carousel, your major line make sense to me. Plenty reasons there to look for a price reaction and trade after the climax that gets retail traders in the wrong direction. I dont pay much heed to round numbers or any other numbers. I am more interested in the reaction at historic places where price reacted before, and the price is a range rather than a fixed value. It pays to treat trading more like art than science where we wont always get a pixel perfect reaction or entry. But sometimes they come incredibly close.

Asia will be online shortly and all I will see is some shut eye while they play with the tiny inter levels.

For the moment up to daily demand is being defended, look at price to see this. For tomorrow we will look to London for their next move. Asia will rarely run with this.

author: Doctor
text:
It has taken some days to work itself out and it is clear now we have a bearish bias on eur/usd. I waited longer than usual so that I could see how the pro's were going to unwind their long positions and not cause too much of a rapid decline. The last week has shown the unwind and price action told all when old areas were hit. The reversal was rather hard and sudden and there is a lot of money going south at the moment and no target for some distance below.

A few charts to help aid you. The 4hr zoomed out first.

You can see how price climbed painfully back into old demand and there was no sign of pro money there, and if no buyers came in when that area was reached it was a given that price will either consolidate or fall. The out come as you know now was a dramatic fall. It shoild not come of much a surprise given the sell offs further up, but the old demand area put up a fight for a few days. Seeing price come back up underneath us next should also be no surprise, unless the bears really want to push hard into their target which on the large time frame is a nice long run.

A closer look this time with the 30min chart.

The top blue line is support and resistance and price reacted off this line showing bearish intent. This was a warning of impending doom to those who were long or thinking of going long. The old decision area was also nicely placed to the left to help keep minds focused on where price will lead us. Note on the bottom of the chart there is a weak buying area and this too shows little pro money coming in for longs, there is no follow through. As price heads back to resistance note the last major bullish candle and a later change in bias with price setting up a nice S/R area and it was only in that price action area where we could see some clarity and intent of pro money. it is clear we had a concerted effort to push price hard into the old demand area and it stalled only for a little while before breaking through. Only at this point was I willing to sell.

Finally a 1min chart for some entries and you wont often see me post these low time frames, its very hard to tell where anyone got an entry off a 1min chart, but if you look for the places where price went back up into supply and the broker spread, you will see my entries. I have many overlayed entries on this chart and all are within a tidy and relatively small support/resistance price range and where there is clear bearish bias in the market. It made sense to only sell in there.

Dont forget the higher time frames and we now are in a new month and be sure to review the monthly chart for February and this weeks closing weekly candle to see where we are.

Bad news hid this change in bias and the pro money unwind took its toll on longs for a good portion of the week, there is blood on these charts!

Now you have some logical thinking ahead of you, where is the most obvious bearish target and where are the bulls likely to come in. Hindering your efforts will be much bearish action on all time frames and nothing to guide you for near term demand, because there is none. All we have to fresh air on the left of price, price falls when there is no demand or support......so we wait.

While we wait, this is how the bulls look today. I like this piccy.

author: Doctor
text:
For those who are not scalpers or break out traders you have already much information in this site on what to do.

When the market breaks out you wait for a pull back to the origin of the move or at least into the origin area i.e within the full extension of the candles near the origin. This revisit is pro money looking to either add more positions or have the break out appear as a false break trapping those who are trigger happy.

What you risk in the search for profit determines what kind of trader you are. Speaking for myself I will only trade off areas where it is clear pro money is active and the direction also clear.

At the moment we have had a break, now I wait for a retest of the origin, then price action. To my eyes, if the move is not a continuation move down I will not take a bullish entry no matter how good it looks.

Where you pull the trigger and in what direction is your call alone Castus.

author: extremerrage
text:
doc in your own opinion what is a pullback? and why it happens?

is it to induce

more orders at a certain level?

author: Doctor
text:
It serves multiple purposes. Take out stops, fill orders in the opposite direction, increase momentum and give the impression the move is reversing. Pro money will trade against itself, for a time. It is necessary to help filter in more orders.

Taking a position in a pull back is counter intuitive to most traders and the thoughts of scaling with orders in the opposite direction to price movement is hard for them to do. It is not logical in their minds.
